title: Research: admit sharp T16 profile at conditional kappa 0.001674088611862992
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR3403 near-selected sharp T16 owner map
- feasibility on supplied windows, physical admission open
+ actual source-event windows and 9,967 emitted charts checked
+ unchanged complete strict controller and typed paid invoice
+ conditional kappa = 0.001674088611862992
```

Answers PR3403's first open question for idle profile `{1:2431,17:1,48:4887}`. The conditional finite exponent improves on selected `0.001672660197076918` by exactly `0.000001428414786074`, and exceeds PR3390's published T16 candidate `0.001673677688974651`. The selected record remains unchanged.

`research/t16-sharp-profile-admission/` retains the exact PR3403 source and PR3338 strict-replay adapter, reconstructs every literal owner, derives PLAN/SPEC, authenticates actual windows and prices both suppliers. The entire typed paid invoice equals the selected invoice except three live source-binding hashes. No optimizer or solver enters replay.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3403 explicitly omitted independent program-derived windows and full chart/controller/stock admission. **After:** all eleven unchanged strict stages pass for 69,120 whole-helper roles and 144 calls, including actual chart construction, scalar/frame/phase audit, stock, finite invoice and all 47 outer inequalities.
- Native complex endpoint `1676895884165954931459/10^24`; bit endpoint unchanged at `1733427039589844234749/10^24`. Two exact engines certify the endpoint and reject its next `10^-24` grid point. Conservative kappa is `0.001674088609009798`.
- Prefix 397 charged at 512; row coefficient 16,469 below 20,161. All 69 admission, 12 bit, 15 controller, 6 independent T16 and 11 independent owner controls pass. Seven new behavior groups pass under ordinary and optimized Python, including actual CLI source mutation and typed invoice faults. Full admission correctly refuses disabled ancestral assertions.
- Registered Python 3.12.15 replay, full-package Ruff, formatting, metadata, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight and Git-free committed export pass. The export's full admission and both test modes leave all 59 files unchanged, including the transport manifest. Commit `391d02ced8e620d8f06aeda1ebe02f099d37af92`.

Replay: `TMPDIR="$RUN_ROOT/scratch" python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-sharp-profile-admission`, with a new owned external RUN_ROOT. README gives the committed export commands. Proof, literal data, full source pins, original strict receipt, exact result, rejection controls and open next questions are included.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1885#discussioncomment-19009153

Credit Ali Romman, Hanson Sun, PR3352/3364/3378/3395/3403, Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan/FanPUYen, Philippe Van Velzen, Josie Elliston and the retained geometry/native/compiler/PR3338/PR589 lineage. PR3390 and PR3396 remain separately credited complementary work.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

This adds one research package. Authenticated selected native ancestry is reused, without rebuilding the full PR1005/1018 chain. All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer and bit H1-H5 remain inherited assumptions. No global packing optimum, unconditional multiplication theorem, selected-frontier update, independent human review or hosted-CI success is claimed.
